adze: A monstrous blood-drinking FIREFLY the size of a cat, an insect with six thin black legs, a glowing yellow-green abdomen, translucent veined beetle wings, and a LONG SHARP NEEDLE MOUTHPART like a mosquito, a faint unsettling human cast to its small head, no tools, no hands, purely an insect
agropelter: A lanky forest creature with a slender weasel-like body and VERY LONG WIRY ARMS far longer than its legs, grey-brown fur, a narrow grinning face, ONE LONG ARM DRAWN BACK OVER ITS SHOULDER holding a heavy dead branch like a spear about to be thrown, isolated figure
amikuk: A skinless creature with FOUR LONG MUSCULAR ARMS AND NO LEGS AT ALL, the body ending in a smooth tapering tail, glistening raw red-brown flesh, a completely SMOOTH EYELESS FEATURELESS HEAD with no face, arms splayed as if swimming, boneless and fluid, isolated figure
asanbosam: A gaunt long-limbed creature HANGING UPSIDE DOWN, its legs ending in CURVED IRON HOOKS OF DARK METAL instead of feet, the hooks clearly hard forged iron catching the light, ashen skin over a bony frame, very long arms dangling downward, a wide mouth of iron teeth, isolated figure
baize: A noble lion-bodied beast with THE BEARDED FACE OF AN OLD MAN instead of a lion's face, human eyes and a long grey beard, SIX CURVED HORNS on its head and NINE EYES set over its brow and flanks, golden fur, seated upright, wise and calm, isolated figure
bannik: A small wizened bathhouse spirit, tiny and gnarled, WREATHED IN THICK WHITE STEAM that half hides him, wet grey hair and beard plastered flat, skin reddened by heat, VERY LONG CURVED CLAWS on his fingers, crouching on bare wet boards, no furniture, isolated figure
betobetosan: A small rounded dark shadow creature whose face is almost entirely ONE ENORMOUS WIDE WHITE SMILE and two small round eyes, body a soft dark grey silhouette with no arms, standing on TWO SMALL BARE FEET IN STRAW SANDALS, softly shaded and slightly translucent at the edges, isolated figure
bulgasari: A HEAVY FOUR-LEGGED BEAST standing on all fours like a bear, NOT a person and NOT wearing armour, with a single rhinoceros horn on its snout, a short elephant-like trunk, an ox tail, and its shaggy hide STUDDED ALL OVER WITH IRON NAILS AND SCRAPS OF METAL IT HAS EATEN, chewing an iron bar
bultungin: A person CAUGHT HALFWAY INTO BECOMING A HYENA, the head and one shoulder already a spotted hyena with a sloping back, ONE HAND STILL AN ORDINARY HUMAN HAND and the other a heavy clawed paw, a blacksmith's scorched leather apron, a hammer, the transformation visibly incomplete
camahueto: A YOUNG BULL CALF, small and short-legged, with EXACTLY ONE SINGLE STRAIGHT CRYSTAL HORN growing from the middle of its forehead and NO OTHER HORNS AT ALL, damp earth and torn roots clinging to its flanks and hooves as if it has just pushed up out of the ground, dark wet hide
centaur: A centaur, ONE SINGLE FUSED CREATURE, the bare torso of a bearded man GROWING DIRECTLY OUT OF THE SHOULDERS OF A HORSE where the horse's neck would be. There is NO RIDER, NO SADDLE and NO HORSE'S HEAD - the man's torso replaces the horse's neck and head entirely. Chestnut coat, carrying a bow
chullachaqui: An ordinary-looking man in a simple smock standing in a clear open pose, the whole of both legs and both feet clearly visible, ONE FOOT IS A CLOVEN DEER HOOF and THE OTHER FOOT IS TURNED COMPLETELY BACKWARDS with the heel at the front and toes pointing behind him, a fixed unnatural smile
curupira: A small boy-sized forest guardian with BRIGHT FLAME-RED HAIR and green-brown skin, shown standing so that BOTH FEET ARE FULLY VISIBLE AND BOTH POINT BACKWARDS, heels forward and toes pointing behind him, an obvious and deliberate reversal, holding a length of vine, fierce expression
dakuwaqa: A creature that is a MAN ABOVE THE WAIST AND A SHARK BELOW, the tattooed torso of a muscular warrior joined at the hips to THE LOWER BODY AND POWERFUL TAIL OF A LARGE GREY SHARK with NO HUMAN LEGS AT ALL, and a shark's head with jaws in place of a human head, scarred grey hide
domovoi: A tiny old MAN the size of a cat, entirely human with NO ANIMAL FEATURES AT ALL, almost completely hidden by an ENORMOUS BUSHY GREY BEARD that reaches his feet, bright shrewd human eyes, a scrap of red cloth for clothing, bare human hands holding a crust of bread, isolated figure
douen: The spirit of a small child with a COMPLETELY BLANK SMOOTH FACE - no eyes, no nose, no mouth at all - under a WIDE STRAW HAT, wearing a plain smock, standing so BOTH BARE FEET ARE CLEARLY VISIBLE AND BOTH ARE TURNED BACKWARDS with heels at the front, isolated figure
dullahan: A HEADLESS rider standing beside a black horse, the neck a clean empty stump, holding HIS OWN SEVERED HUMAN HEAD ALOFT in one raised hand - a living human head with mouldy pale skin, a huge grin stretching ear to ear and darting eyes, NOT a skull - and a whip of human spine in the other hand
eloko: A small forest dwarf with LONG GREEN GRASS GROWING OUT OF ITS SCALP INSTEAD OF HAIR, skin dark and textured like tree bark, a mouth far too wide for its face filled with small pointed teeth, piercing yellow eyes, HOLDING UP A SMALL CARVED WOODEN BELL in one hand, isolated figure
ghul: A gaunt desert grave-shapeshifter, NOT a wolf and NOT furry - ashen grey CRACKED DRY SKIN stretched over long thin limbs, clawed hands, a head that is part spotted hyena and part human with a wide mouth of long teeth, wrapped in TATTERED GREY BURIAL CLOTH, hunched low, isolated figure
golem: A massive humanoid figure CRUDELY SHAPED OUT OF GREY-BROWN RIVER CLAY, rough and unfinished with VISIBLE THUMBPRINTS, FINGER GOUGES AND TOOL MARKS all over its surface, lumpy asymmetric limbs, a nearly blank face with hollow pits for eyes, and HEBREW LETTERS CARVED INTO ITS FOREHEAD
hidebehind: A tall impossibly thin forest creature MOSTLY CONCEALED BEHIND A NARROW TREE TRUNK, with ONLY one long clawed arm, one thin leg and HALF OF A NARROW SNARLING FACE visible past the edge of the trunk, the rest of it hidden by the tree, dark bark-coloured hide, peering out
huakaipo: A SEMI-TRANSPARENT GHOSTLY Hawaiian warrior, the figure faintly see-through with a soft blue-white glow at its edges, wearing a feathered cloak and crested feather helmet, carrying a burning torch and a spear, eyes blank and unseeing, ghostly and insubstantial rather than solid
huldra: A woman seen FROM DIRECTLY BEHIND in a woollen dress, with a LONG COW'S TAIL, and HER ENTIRE BACK IS A HOLLOW OPENING like the inside of a rotted tree trunk - a dark concave cavity lined with bark and rotten wood where her back should be, glancing over her shoulder at the viewer
ifrit: A towering jinn whose body is made of DARK SWIRLING SMOKE with MOLTEN ORANGE CRACKS glowing through it like cooling lava, two long curved horns, blazing white eyes, powerful arms crossed, and THE LOWER BODY DISSOLVING ENTIRELY INTO A COLUMN OF SMOKE with no legs or feet
ijiraq: An Arctic shapeshifter that is part caribou and part human, bare and ancient rather than clothed, with caribou antlers and long thin limbs, and ITS FACE DELIBERATELY BLURRED, SMEARED AND INDISTINCT as if it cannot be looked at directly, the edges of the whole figure dissolving into white snow-glare
jengu: A water spirit with dark skin and VERY LONG WAVY BLACK HAIR, SMILING BROADLY WITH HER MOUTH OPEN TO SHOW A WIDE OBVIOUS GAP BETWEEN HER TWO FRONT TEETH, a blue and silver fish tail below the waist, cowrie shells woven into her hair, warm and healing rather than seductive
jiangshi: A stiff corpse in QING DYNASTY OFFICIAL ROBES AND A FLAT BLACK CAP, its BOTH ARMS HELD OUT RIGIDLY STRAIGHT FORWARD IN FRONT OF ITS CHEST, parallel and level, body held completely rigid with legs together MID-HOP off the ground, greenish-white mottled skin, A YELLOW PAPER TALISMAN HANGING DOWN OVER ITS FACE
jorogumo: A woman from the waist up joined to THE LARGE BODY OF A GOLDEN ORB-WEAVER SPIDER, with EIGHT LONG BLACK-AND-BRIGHT-YELLOW BANDED SPIDER LEGS spread wide around her, the spider abdomen large and boldly striped yellow and black, a patterned kimono over the human half, silk strands trailing
kamapuaa: An enormous black boar with bristled shoulders and upcurved tusks, with EIGHT EYES clearly arranged in two rows of four across its broad face and EIGHT STOUT LEGS beneath its body, all eight legs visible and countable, tufts of torn fern in its coarse coat, steam at the nostrils
kasaobake: An old torn paper umbrella creature with ONE LARGE EYE in the centre of its canopy, a LONG RED TONGUE lolling from a wide grinning mouth, and BALANCED HOPPING ON EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LEG ending in one wooden sandal - it has NO ARMS and NO SECOND LEG, only the umbrella, one eye and one foot
knocker: A TINY WIZENED OLD MINER no taller than a boot, ancient deeply wrinkled brown face with an enormous bulbous nose, a SOFT LEATHER CAP WITH A LIT CANDLE STUB STUCK TO IT WITH CLAY, rough old-fashioned work clothes thick with coal dust, holding a small pick, a knowing sideways look
likho: A gaunt skeletally thin towering figure in tattered black rags, with EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LARGE EYE in the centre of an otherwise hollow bony face and NO SECOND EYE AT ALL, long grasping bony fingers, hunched forward, an air of exhausted grinding misfortune
lusca: An ENORMOUS menacing octopus filling the frame, vast thick muscular arms with rows of pale suckers coiling outward, a huge mottled rust-brown and grey mantle, ONE GREAT COLD EYE prominent and staring, arms rising out of dark blue water, immense in scale and threatening
mapinguari: A huge shaggy red-brown GIANT GROUND SLOTH rearing up on its hind legs, with ENORMOUS LONG CURVED CLAWS on its forelimbs, thick armoured plated hide, a SINGLE EYE in the middle of its face, and A LARGE OPEN FANGED MOUTH SET IN THE MIDDLE OF ITS BELLY, roaring
medjed: A small simple figure COMPLETELY DRAPED IN A PLAIN WHITE SHEET from head to floor, with only TWO ROUND STARING EYES on the sheet and A PAIR OF BARE HUMAN FEET protruding at the bottom, drawn flat and simple in the style of an ancient Egyptian papyrus painting, faint rays from the eyes
nanaue: A powerfully built man seen FROM DIRECTLY BEHIND, his cloak fallen away to expose HIS BARE BACK, and SET INTO THE MIDDLE OF HIS UPPER BACK BETWEEN HIS SHOULDER BLADES IS AN ENORMOUS OPEN SHARK'S MOUTH full of teeth. The shark mouth is on his BACK, not his chest. His human face turns to look over his shoulder
nasnas: EXACTLY HALF OF A MAN, cut cleanly down the middle from head to groin, with ONE arm, ONE leg, HALF a head with a single eye and half a mouth, and the entire cut side FLAT AND OPEN like a cross-section. He is visibly only half a body, hopping on the single foot, half a robe hanging
nurikabe: A VERY WIDE FLAT WALL, much wider than it is tall, a broad slab of pale grey plaster filling the frame horizontally, with TWO SMALL ROUND EYES and a tiny mouth low on its surface and TWO SHORT STUMPY LEGS beneath - a wall first and a creature second, blank and immovable
nyaminyami: A river god with THE HEAD OF A LARGE WHISKERED FISH - a broad blunt fish head with round fish eyes, gills and long barbels, NOT a snake head - joined to a long thick coiling serpent body covered in muddy gold and green scales, carved Tonga patterning down the flanks
penghou: A PLAIN GLOSSY BLACK DOG WITH NO TAIL, ordinary and unremarkable in build, standing FULL BODY AND PROMINENT in the foreground, filling most of the frame, with the split trunk of a felled camphor tree small behind it, a mild puzzled expression
pincoya: A sea spirit with LONG TANGLED GOLDEN-GREEN SEAWEED HAIR full of kelp and shells, dressed in woven strands of kelp, DANCING BAREFOOT ON WET SAND with both arms raised and her face turned toward the open sea, skin faintly luminous, sea spray around her feet
redcap: A squat powerful OLD GOBLIN with ORDINARY GREY-GREEN WRINKLED SKIN, long lank grey hair and a wizened face with sunken red eyes, wearing HEAVY BLACK IRON BOOTS and a WOOLLEN CAP SOAKED DARK WITH DRIED BLOOD, carrying a long iron pikestaff, long yellow talons
shahmaran: Shahmaran, a crowned woman from the waist up and a long coiling serpent below, with SEVERAL SMALL SNAKE HEADS RISING FROM THE COILS OF HER OWN SERPENT BODY, each little head alert with open mouth, a jewelled crown and headdress, painted in flat bright Anatolian folk-art style
snallygaster: A half-bird half-reptile with wide LEATHERY BAT WINGS, a LONG POINTED BEAK OF GLEAMING METAL LINED WITH SHARP TEETH, and EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LARGE EYE IN THE CENTRE OF ITS FOREHEAD with no other eyes, several octopus-like tentacles trailing beneath its body, mottled grey-green hide
soucouyant: An old woman MID-TRANSFORMATION: HER SKIN IS PEELED OFF DOWN ONE SIDE OF HER BODY EXPOSING RAW RED MUSCLE, and she carries THE EMPTY LOOSE HUMAN SKIN DRAPED OVER ONE ARM like a shed garment, while her upper body burns away into a ball of orange flame, streaking upward
tartalo: A massive one-eyed shepherd giant with EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LARGE EYE IN THE CENTRE OF HIS FOREHEAD and NO OTHER EYES AT ALL - no eye sockets to either side, just smooth brow - a thick black beard and matted hair, wearing rough sheepskins, holding a crook, crude and enormous
tiyanak: A creature with THE BODY AND PROPORTIONS OF A HUMAN INFANT - fat little arms and legs, a large round baby's head, plump cheeks - but with a WIDE MOUTH FULL OF LONG SHARP TEETH and GLOWING RED EYES, lying on its back in undergrowth with its arms raised to be picked up, uncanny and wrong
tupilaq: A small grotesque creature CRUDELY ASSEMBLED FROM MISMATCHED ANIMAL PARTS LASHED TOGETHER - a seal's skull, a bird's wing, a fish tail, human finger bones - the joins bound with visible sinew and gut cord, deliberately lopsided and badly made, carved bone texture, snarling
veli: A small Fijian forest spirit CHILD-LIKE FIGURE WITH A CLEARLY VISIBLE DARK FACE and large dark eyes, slender limbs, wearing a crown of leaves and flowers ABOVE the face so the face is not covered, holding a sprig of a rare plant protectively, gentle and watchful
xiezhi: A powerful goat-like beast with EXACTLY ONE SINGLE LONG STRAIGHT HORN growing from the centre of its forehead and NO OTHER HORNS, thick dark shaggy fur, leonine clawed paws, bright fierce eyes, head lowered as if about to gore, drawn in Chinese imperial style
zduhac: The spirit of a BEARDED PEASANT FARMER IN OLD-FASHIONED ROUGH HOMESPUN LINEN SHIRT AND WOOLLEN TROUSERS, no modern clothing, rising up into a storm with both arms raised, HIS LOWER BODY DISSOLVING INTO SWIRLING GREY STORM CLOUD, lightning crackling around his hands
